title: Will the RPC finish inside one deadline?
description: Use measured network and service durations, then inject transient failures. Every attempt and backoff consumes the original call deadline.
assumption: Network and service inputs must come from traces and representative load tests at a declared percentile and load. The model adds budgets; it does not predict latency or include unknown queueing and tail correlation.

operations.label: Read-only lookup
operations.detail: Repeating the request creates no additional application effect.

operations.label: Keyed reservation
operations.detail: A durable idempotency key returns the same logical mutation result on replay.

operations.label: Unkeyed create
operations.detail: The server may commit before the result is lost, so another attempt can duplicate the effect.
